Highlands Production · Livemix Pro Simulator
ABOUT THIS SIMULATOR

Practice behavior.
Understand the boundaries.

This independent simulation recreates selected Livemix Pro Solo training workflows. It does not load or execute firmware, process audio, or communicate with a unit.

Mapped behavior

16-tile channel layout and right-side menus; Mix Tools and Local Mix Options routes; display choices; 15 hot-key assignments and defaults; group confirmation and staging boundaries; separate pending ME assignment; mix naming and recall flow.

Training assumptions

The supplied physical-unit photograph supplies the enclosure and hardware appearance. The user guide v1.37 supplies the screen palette, cells, selection borders, sliders, status bar and page layouts. The live display and control hit areas are registered over the photo; fonts and registration are approximate. The included training profile defines 64 channel names, 13 stereo pairs, 16 groups and their membership. Level/balance scales, synthetic activity and browser persistence remain model choices. Stereo volume, balance, mute, solo, reverb and membership are linked; this is a behavioral model with no audio processing.

Available here

64-channel level/balance/mute/solo, linked L/R pairs, group setup/name/membership, ME assignment, reverb inclusion, master compression/HPF/reverb/output, display and double-tap options, hot keys, 30 browser mix slots, four guided workflows: Loading a Mix, Saving a Mix, Working With Groups and Adjust Reverb.

Outside this version

Original-code execution, audio/DSP, EQ, MirrorMix/networking, USB/media, updates, clock/passcode, accessory configuration and device timing. Unsupported controls explain their boundary.

Keyboard & accessibility

Tab to any control; Enter/Space activates. Up/Down adjusts the selected channel, Left/Right pans. M toggles its mute; S toggles solo; 1/2 invokes a hot key; Escape returns. Focused knobs support arrows. A tile hold opens detail; Selected detail below the unit provides a keyboard path. Press MASTER for output settings; hold it for four seconds to mute. Press ME to toggle channel/group views. Touch/drag gestures are browser conveniences, not validated physical input behavior.

Sandbox state and saved mixes stay in this browser’s local storage. On the first reload of this patch revision, names, links and group metadata update in working and saved mixes; existing control values and preferences are retained where valid. Newly linked pairs take their left channel’s values. A pre-update backup stays in this browser. Reset sandbox clears them. Guided workflows start with a fresh practice mix and prepare START MIX in slot 01. Other saved slots remain available; the Saving a Mix exercise writes slot 02 when you choose Save. The live interface is reconstructed in HTML/CSS from the manual. The supplied unit photograph is included locally and embedded in the offline export; no firmware, PDF screenshots or vendor font files are included.

Independent training simulation. The supplied unit photograph and Highlands logo are embedded; no external assets are required.
